title: Take a question home
body: A land-use change is proposed near you. Choose a question you would want answered. Each is a useful starting point.

choices.text: Whose productive-land needs would this change serve?
choices.explanation: Ask what evidence supports those needs and which uses would lose space.

choices.text: What vegetation would be kept, changed or restored?
choices.explanation: Ask how the alternatives use the same limited land and what trade-offs they create.

choices.text: Where would runoff go, and what assumptions support the estimate?
choices.explanation: Ask which areas connect to proposed water measures and what happens when their capacity is reached.
